title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Event
description: event with common attributes. (TM Forum TMF688 Event Streaming API 4.0.0, Swagger definition Event; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Event:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Event'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

correlationId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF688-Event/blob/a88d5266404d6b1f38504a9bdc149d636ccf4ab2/TMF688-Event-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Event/properties/correlationId'. The correlation id for this event.

domain.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF688-Event/blob/a88d5266404d6b1f38504a9bdc149d636ccf4ab2/TMF688-Event-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Event/properties/domain'. The domain of the event.

eventId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF688-Event/blob/a88d5266404d6b1f38504a9bdc149d636ccf4ab2/TMF688-Event-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Event/properties/eventId'. The identifier of the notification.

eventType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF688-Event/blob/a88d5266404d6b1f38504a9bdc149d636ccf4ab2/TMF688-Event-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Event/properties/eventType'. The type of the notification.

timeOcurred.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF688-Event/blob/a88d5266404d6b1f38504a9bdc149d636ccf4ab2/TMF688-Event-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Event/properties/timeOcurred'. The time the event occured.
